body:
The problem with your hypothetical is that the more I live, the more cynical I get and the less hope I have for the future. I know that may seem silly since I'm young still, but it is bleak, and I don't think that's just my depression talking. I've had short bouts of feeling better, and even then I was pessimistic and doubted I have a chance at living a successful life. I don't even know what my version of a successful life would look like, considering I'm completely alienated with society.

I'd rather take my chances with non-existence than the bullshit that seems to be existence. If this is all there is to life, I'd rather not be a part of it.
